_definitions.about: Machine-readable reference for this file. Keys beginning with _ are documentation, not card ids.

context.what: A generic dictionary built by the event being evaluated. Value refs read it by key.

event_keys.self: The card whose rule/condition is being evaluated.
event_keys.source: The card that caused the event (damage source, effect source, ...); may be null.
event_keys.target: The card affected by the event.
event_keys.amount: Current damage amount; updated after each damage modifier.
event_keys.source_kind: Summon or Ability when the caller knows it.
event_keys.source_controller: Controller of the event source when known.

value_ref.literal: A number, string or bool is used as-is.

damage_modifiers.what: Replacement effects applied before damage lands. Every rule on every card on the field is asked.

fields.targets: CardTarget criteria; evaluated with the rule owner as source.
fields.conditions: One block or an array of blocks; all must be true.
fields.consume_status: Optional status erased from the target when the rule applies.

damage_modifiers.pending_status_payloads: A status whose payload has operation and value modifies incoming damage to that card. It is consumed after applying unless the payload says once: false; its duration expires in turn_end() if unused.

conditions.compare_values: Object {left, op, right}; op is eq, neq, lt, lte, gt or gte.
conditions.source_is_self: source == self. Use for 'if this card deals damage'.
conditions.in_party_with_self: target and self are both members of the current attacking party.
conditions.source_kind: String or array matched against source_kind.

targets.is_type: Exact card type: Forward, Backup, Summon, Monster.
targets.is_element: Element key, e.g. 火, 氷, 風, 土, 雷, 水, 光, 闇.
targets.is_job: Job contains this string (case-insensitive); all_jobs matches every job.
targets.is_character: Type is Forward, Backup or Monster.
targets.controller: player / opponent, or mine / yours / theirs relative to the rule source.
targets.check_controller: Legacy spelling routed through the same controller rule.
targets.exclude: A criteria block, or array of blocks, that the card must NOT match.
targets.is_source: The candidate is the rule/effect source.
targets.count: Number of targets for a targeting session.

triggers.when_enter_field: When this card enters the field.
triggers.when_blocks: When this card is declared as a blocker.
triggers.when_chosen: When this card is chosen by an opponent's Summon or ability.
triggers.when_cause_damage_to_player: When this card deals damage to a player.
triggers.when_enter_break_from_field: When this card is put from the field into the Break Zone.
triggers.when_party_attack: When this card forms a party and attacks.
triggers.when_party_attacks: When a party you control attacks.
triggers.when_party_deals_damage: When a party you control deals damage to the opponent.
triggers.ex_burst: Effect resolved when this card becomes damage; value names the trigger to execute.
triggers.aura: Continuous effect; method is power_change or grant_status.
triggers.conditional_power: Self power bonus while a condition holds.
triggers.power_per: Power per matching card or per point of damage received.
triggers.protects: Prevents cards matching targets from being broken by the given causes.
triggers.shields: Prevents cards matching targets from being chosen by the given causes.
triggers.cost_aura: Modifies the cost of matching cards.
triggers.self_cost: Modifies this card's own cost while a condition holds.
triggers.on_character_enter: Static rule applied when a Character enters the field.
triggers.on_causing_damage_to_forward: Rider attached to a Forward damaged by this card.
triggers.break_zone_exile: While on the field, Characters put into the Break Zone may be exiled instead.
triggers.cannot_be_blocked_by: Printed restriction on which Forwards may block this card.
triggers.cannot_block: Printed restriction on which Forwards this card may block.
triggers.party_brave: This card grants Brave to party members while it is in the party.
triggers.all_jobs: This card counts as every job.
triggers.ex_burst_disabler: Damage from this card suppresses EX Burst.
triggers.apply_effect: Top-level target set for the trigger or skill; used by mass instructions.

skill_fields.cost: Mana cost by element plus neutral.
skill_fields.tap: Dull the source as part of the cost.
skill_fields.s_cost: Discard a card with the same name as part of the cost.
skill_fields.sacrifice: Put a matching card, or is_source, into the Break Zone as a cost.
skill_fields.discard: Discard N cards as a cost.
skill_fields.only_your_turn: Can be activated only during its controller's turn.
skill_fields.only_if_blocking: Can be activated only while the source is blocking.
skill_fields.text: Human-readable ability text for the choice window.
skill_fields.apply_effect: Target set for the skill's instructions.
skill_fields.choose_target: Targeting criteria; may be a staged array.
skill_fields.instructions: Instruction list resolved on the stack.

instructions.add_status_effect: Add a status to the source card. Optional third argument is a payload dictionary, e.g. {"operation": "set", "value": 0} for a next-damage shield.
instructions.add_status_to_targets: Add a status to every chosen target.
instructions.break_zone_to_hand: Choose a card in the Break Zone and add it to hand.
instructions.cancel_targets: Remove chosen cards from the stack.
instructions.cast_summon_for_free: Cast a Summon from hand without paying.
instructions.damage_targets: Deal N damage to every chosen target.
instructions.discard_cards: Discard N cards from the effect controller's hand.
instructions.divide_damage: Apply the split chosen for the selected targets.
instructions.extra_attacks_from_damage: Allow extra attacks equal to damage taken.
instructions.look_top_may_bottom: Look at the top card; may put it on the bottom.
instructions.may_play_for_free: May play a matching card for free.
instructions.opponent_discards: The opponent of the effect controller discards N.
instructions.opponent_mills: The opponent of the effect controller mills N.
instructions.play_from_break_zone: Choose a matching Break Zone card and play it.
instructions.play_from_hand: Choose a matching hand card and play it.
instructions.power_change: Change the source or target's power.
instructions.power_change_matching: Change power of all cards matching criteria.
instructions.power_change_party: Change power of all party members.
instructions.power_change_targets: Change power of every chosen target.
instructions.power_change_targets_if_blocking: Change power; different amount while blocking.
instructions.put_hand_card_on_bottom: Choose a hand card and put it on the bottom of the deck.
instructions.return_from_break_zone: Return the source from the Break Zone to the field.
instructions.return_targets_to_hand: Return every chosen target to its owner's hand.
instructions.search_deck: Search the deck with a filter; destination is optional.
instructions.suffer_damage: Make the source card suffer damage.

statuses.summoning_sickness: Cannot tap until the next Active Phase.
statuses.frozen: Does not activate in the next Active Phase.
statuses.skip_next_active: Skips the next Active Phase and is consumed.
statuses.fragile: Exiled instead of entering the Break Zone.
statuses.next_receiving_damage: Payload status: operation/value modifies damage to this card, once by default; set once:false for a duration-long shield. The status name is only a label.
